G2300.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G2300.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit:--behold, look (upon), see. Compare «3700».

G2301.def: from «2302»; to expose as a spectacle:--make a gazing stock.

G2302.def: from «2300»; a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively):--spectacle, theatre.

G2303.et: probably of (2304) (in its original sense of flashing)
G2303.def: probably neuter of «2304» (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur:--brimstone.

G2304.def: from «2316»; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity): - divine, godhead.

G2307.def: from the prolonged form of «2309»; a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure, will.

G2308.def: from «2309»; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.

G2309.et: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of (138)
G2309.def: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of «138»; to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas «1014» properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in:--desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly)).

G2310.def: from a derivative of «5087»; something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively):--foundation.

G2311.def: from «2310»; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.

G2312.def: from «2316» and «1321»; divinely instructed:--taught of God.

G2313.def: from «2314»; to resist deity:--fight against God.

G2314.def: from «2316» and «3164»; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.

G2315.et: from (2316) and a presumed derivative of (4154)
G2315.def: from «2316» and a presumed derivative of «4154»; divinely breathed in:--given by inspiration of God.

G2316.et: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with (3588)) the supreme Divinity
G2316.def: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with «3588») the supreme Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very:--X exceeding, God, god(-ly, -ward).

G2318.def: from «2316» and «4576»; reverent of God, i.e. pious:--worshipper of God.

G2319.def: from «2316» and the base of «4767»; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater of God.

G2321.def: from «2316» and «5384»; friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian:--Theophilus.

G2322.def: from «2323»; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.

G2323.def: from the same as «2324»; to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease):--cure, heal, worship.

G2324.et: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of (2330)
G2324.def: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of «2330»; a menial attendant (as if cherishing):--servant.

G2325.et: from (2330) (in the sense of the crop)
G2325.def: from «2330» (in the sense of the crop); to harvest:--reap.

G2330.def: from a primary thero (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer:--summer.

G2331.def: from «2332»; a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice:--Thessalonian.

G2332.def: from Thessalos (a Thessalian) and «3529»; Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor:--Thessalonica.

G2333.def: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.

G2334.et: from a derivative of (2300) (perhaps by add. of (3708))
G2334.def: from a derivative of «2300» (perhaps by addition of «3708»); to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge)):--behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare «3700».

G2335.def: from the same as «2334»; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle:--sight.

G2337.def: from thele (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck:--(give) suck(-ling).

G2338.def: from the same as «2337»; female:--female, woman.

G2339.et: from ther (a wild animal, as game)
G2339.def: from ther (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction:--trap.

G2340.def: from «2339»; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at:--catch.

G2341.def: from a compound of «2342» and «3164»; to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious men):--fight with wild beasts.

G2342.def: diminutive from the same as «2339»; a dangerous animal:--(venomous, wild) beast.

G2343.def: from «2344»; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively):--lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

G2344.def: from «5087»; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively):--treasure.

G2345.et: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary thigo (to finger)
G2345.def: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary thigo (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle, touch.

G2346.def: akin to the base of «5147»; to crowd (literally or figuratively):--afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.

G2347.def: from «2346»; pressure (literally or figuratively):--afflicted(-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

G2348.et: a strengthened form of a simpler primary thano {than'-o} (which is used for it only in certain tenses)
G2348.def: a strengthened form of a simpler primary thano than'-o (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or figuratively):--be dead, die.

G2350.def: from «2351»; to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor:--make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.

G2351.def: from the base of «2360»; a disturbance:--tumult, uproar.

G2352.def: a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare «4486».

G2353.def: from «5142»; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.

G2356.def: from a derivative of «2357»; ceremonial observance:--religion, worshipping.

G2357.def: probably from the base of «2360»; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.

G2358.et: from a prolonged compound of the base of (2360)
G2358.def: from a prolonged compound of the base of «2360»; and a derivative of «680» (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory:--(cause) to triumph (over).

G2359.et: genitive case trichos, etc., of uncertain derivation
G2359.def: genitive case trichos, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair. Compare «2864».

G2360.def: from threomai to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten:--trouble.

G2361.et: perhaps from (5142) (in the sense of thickening)
G2361.def: perhaps from «5142» (in the sense of thickening); a clot:--great drop.

G2362.et: from thrao (to sit), a stately seat ("throne")
G2362.def: from thrao (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate:--seat, throne.

G2363.def: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.

G2364.def: apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant):--daughter.

G2366.def: from «2380» (in the sense of blowing) a storm:--tempest.

G2367.et: from a derivative of (2380) (in the sense of blowing, denoting a certain fragrant tree)
G2367.def: from a derivative of «2380» (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood:--thyine.

G2368.def: from «2370»; an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself:--incense, odour.

G2369.def: from a derivative of «2370»; a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple):--censer.

G2370.et: from a derivative of (2380) (in the sense of smoking)
G2370.def: from a derivative of «2380» (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.

G2371.et: from a presumed compound of (2372) and (3164)
G2371.def: from a presumed compound of «2372» and «3164»; to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated:--be highly displeased.

G2372.def: from «2380»; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare «5590».

G2373.def: from «2372»; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.

G2374.def: apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively):--door, gate.

G2377.def: from «2374» and ouros (a watcher); a gate- warden:--that kept the door, porter.

G2378.def: from «2380»; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively):--sacrifice.

G2379.def: from a derivative of «2378»; a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative):--altar.

G2380.def: a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose):--kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.

G2381.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «08380»); the twin; Thomas, a Christian:--Thomas.

G2382.def: of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet:--breast-plate.

G2383.def: of Hebrew origin («02971»); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite:--Jairus.

G2384.def: of Hebrew origin («03290»); Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the Israelites:--also an Israelite:--Jacob.

G2385.def: the same as «2384» Graecized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites:--James.

G2387.def: of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian:--Jambres.

G2388.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «03238»); Janna, an Israelite:--Janna.

G2389.def: of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian:--Jannes.

G2390.et: middle voice of apparently a primary verb
G2390.def: middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or figuratively):--heal, make whole.

G2391.def: of Hebrew origin («03382»); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian:--Jared.

G2393.def: probably of foreign origin (see «03471»); "jasper", a gem:--jasper.

G2394.def: future active participle masculine of «2390»; about to cure; Jason, a Christian:--Jason.

G2396.et: second person singular imperative active of (1492)
G2396.def: second person singular imperative active of «1492»; used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!:--behold, lo, see.

G2397.def: from «1492»; a sight (comparative figuratively "idea"), i.e. aspect:--countenance.

G2398.def: of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate:--X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

G2399.def: from «2398»; a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot"):--ignorant, rude, unlearned.
